note: Construction systems and their staged rates. Replace a rate with a vendor bid when one exists; keep the source and date with it.

systems.label: Cob
systems.note: Hand-built earthen walls; labour-heavy, low material cost.

systems.label: Hempcrete
systems.note: Hemp-lime infill with a frame; needs a supplier quote for the mix and a plaster crew.

systems.label: Prefab modular
systems.note: Factory units set on a prepared pad; rate should come with delivery and crane costs.

systems.label: Concrete prefab
systems.note: Precast panels or modules; confirm transport, foundation and erection separately.

systems.label: Stick frame
systems.note: Conventional wood frame; the rate assumes a simple rectangular plan.

systems.label: Steel frame
systems.note: Workshop and storage shells; add insulation and services if the space is occupied.
